title: How to Square Any Number Close to 100
description: A mental-math shortcut for squaring numbers near 100, using the difference of squares.
narration_lines: What's ninety eight squared? There's a fast way using nearby round numbers.
Move two away in each direction. Ninety six times one hundred is nine thousand six hundred.
Then add back two squared, which is four, giving nine thousand six hundred four.
So ninety eight squared is nine thousand six hundred four.
